title: Building a Sustainable and Vibrant Community Arts Ecosystem
what_it_is: Building a Sustainable and Vibrant Community Arts Ecosystem

sections.label: Under-one-roof performing arts housing
sections.summary: Proposes building under-one-roof performing arts housing for music, dance and theatre.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: One, to build under-one-roof performing arts housing for music, dance and theatre.

sections.label: Revisit arts radio and TV
sections.summary: Proposes reconsidering and revisiting the plan to reinstall the arts radio and television channel.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Two, to reconsider and revisit the plan to reinstall the arts radio and television (TV) channel.

sections.label: MCCY arts participation data
sections.summary: MCCY data released 22 January 2019 shows numbers rose from around 7,700 in 2011 to more than 9,500 in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: According to data released by the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) on 22 January 2019, the numbers have increased from around 7,700 in 2011 to more than 9,500 in 2017.

sections.label: Fostering community arts groups
sections.summary: Proposes fostering community arts groups with schools, institutions, alumni and students.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Three, to foster and further the establishment of community arts groups with school, institutions, alumni and students.

sections.label: Passion 99.5 FM and arts growth
sections.summary: NAC's Passion 99.5 FM, set up in 1997, shut down in 2003; MCCY data shows arts performances rose from around 7,700 in 2011 to more than 9,500 in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In 1997, NAC established Passion 99.5 FM to support our Singapore music.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Unfortunately, sponsorship and advertisement income dropped due to the economic downturn, and it was shut down in 2003.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: According to data released by MCCY on 31 January 2019, the number of arts performances has risen from around 7,700 in 2011 to more than 9,500 in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I think with the increase in number in arts events and attendance, we ought to deepen the reach of our performances and productions through the mainstream media.

sections.label: Artists' gross floor area growth
sections.summary: Gross floor area dedicated to artists and arts companies has grown almost five-fold over the last 30 years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: The gross floor area (GFA) that is dedicated to artists and arts companies has grown almost five-fold over the last 30 years.

sections.label: Co-location and shared arts spaces
sections.summary: Rising rental costs and competition for space make co-location and shared spaces necessary so existing spaces benefit more arts practitioners.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Given our limited resources with rising rental costs and increasing competition for space, co-location initiatives and shared spaces are necessary to ensure that our existing spaces are effectively used for the benefit of more arts practitioners.

sections.label: Shared warehouse idea for NAC
sections.summary: Mr Terence Ho's shared warehouse idea is good and NAC will explore it to diversify art space offerings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Mr Terence Ho's idea of a shared warehouse is a good one that NAC will explore as a way to diversify our art space offerings.

sections.label: Hear65 radio partnership shows
sections.summary: Hear65, launched in 2018, partnered UFM 100.3 in 2019 for six shows profiling local artists, drawing over 1,500 audience and 80,000 online views.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: For example, Hear65, a national movement launched in 2018, partnered local radio station UFM 100.3 in 2019 to present six shows profiling our local artists, drawing an audience of over 1,500 and 80,000 views online.

sections.label: Digital cultural initiatives and platforms
sections.summary: MCCY, NAC and NHB are developing digital initiatives like the Cultural Concierge and Cultural Resource Ontology, digitising the national collection and launching platforms such as Roots.sg, NORA and Offstage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: As Minister Grace Fu announced at the 2019 Committee of Supply debate, MCCY, NAC and the National Heritage Board (NHB) are developing new digital initiatives, such as the one-stop online Cultural Concierge for arts and culture activities and content and the Cultural Resource Ontology, to facilitate easier public access to our cultural resources.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: We are actively digitising our national collection and making this accessible through platforms, such as NHB's Roots.sg as well as the National Library Board's National Online Repository of the Arts (NORA).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Most recently, the Esplanade launched a multimedia site Offstage in October 2019, hosting behind-the-scenes, broadcast, interactive and archival content of the performing arts.

sections.label: MCCY and NAC commitment to practitioners
sections.summary: MCCY and NAC are committed to working with arts practitioners towards this end.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: MCCY and NAC are committed to working with our arts practitioners towards this end.
